sections.title: New Year's Day lunch: the details
The first of January at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
New Year’s Day asks for very little: good company, a decent lunch and no washing up. On 1 January we open the restaurant and the conservatory for a slow, easy lunch, for families who gathered the night before, friends starting the year together, and guests who saw the bells in with us and came down to breakfast a little later than usual.

The pace is deliberately gentle. Tables are laid for two or for a dozen, nobody is hurried, and the conservatory, with daylight through the glass, is a pleasant place to sit on a short January afternoon. The menu is simpler than Christmas Day and is confirmed each autumn along with the price and sitting times. Tell us about allergies, dietary needs and children when you book.

If you stayed with us for Hogmanay, lunch is the natural end to the stay: breakfast when you surface, a walk to Strathclyde Country Park about a mile away to clear the head, then lunch before the drive or the train home. Check-out is by 11am, but ask about leaving your bags with us while you eat. Parking is free, and train services are reduced on 1 January, so check times before you travel.

sections.title: The room, the food and the night before

items.title: The restaurant and conservatory
items.text: Tables in our restaurant and in the purpose-built glass conservatory alongside it. Say which you’d prefer when you book and we’ll do our best.

items.title: An easy lunch
items.text: A relaxed menu cooked in our own kitchen, simpler than Christmas Day, with smaller portions for children and dietary needs catered for. Confirmed each autumn.

items.title: After Hogmanay
items.text: Stay with us for the bells, come down to breakfast cooked to order, and finish with lunch before heading home. Our 18 en-suite rooms are upstairs.

sections.title: New Year's Day lunch: what people ask us

items.q: How do we book a table for New Year's Day?
items.a: Call us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry with your numbers. We’ll confirm this year’s menu, price and sitting times and hold your table.

items.q: Do we need to pay a deposit?
items.a: For larger tables we may ask for a deposit. We’ll explain how much, when it is due and our cancellation terms when you book.

items.q: Can you cater for dietary requirements and children?
items.a: Yes. Tell us about allergies, intolerances and vegetarian or vegan guests when you book, and how many children are coming, and we’ll plan smaller portions for them.

items.q: Is there parking, and do trains run on New Year's Day?
items.a: Parking at the hotel is free. Train services are reduced on 1 January, so check times before you travel, or stay the night before and walk down to lunch.
